2nd personal pronoun. mf. (-त्वं)
Thou.
E.
युष Sautra root, to serve, to worship, Uṇādi aff. मदिक्.

n. (-च्यं)
(In grammar,) The second person.
E.
युष्मट्, and वाच्य to be said.

r. 1st cl. (यूषति)
To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.

mn. (-षः-षं)
Pease soup, pease porridge, the water in which pulse of various kinds has been boiled.
m. (-षः)
The mulberry tree, (Morus Indica); also पूष.
E.
यूष to hurt, क aff.
